description:
Owner decision 2026-10-28: users must see which SQL translator produced each run in the Explorer. The read model has no translator column (_project/design/browser-duckdb-schema.sql ~:38-119; read-model version 17 in the explorer pipeline contract.py ~:4). Add per-run `translator_version` plus `translator_version_source` (recorded | attested | not_recorded) and fork_sha, populated by the shared resolver from bundle-translator-version-sidecar-attestation, and bump the read model to 18.

CROSS-REPO CONSTRAINT: the site (BenchBox-dev/benchbox-site) pins read model 17 exactly (explorer-build-contract.mjs ~:5, db.ts ~:48). A core snapshot at 18 must not reach a site build that only accepts 17. Follow the repository's documented read-model bump procedure (find it: docs/internal, _project/design, previous bump PRs from 16 to 17, git log -S 'READ_MODEL_VERSION'); if it is readers-first, the site item lands first and this item updates its needs accordingly.

GUARDRAILS: additive column only; no ranking or identity change; snapshot regeneration through the pipeline's own commands; per-query hashes are out of scope.
